name: failed-add-book-leaves-a-ghost-book
why: a placeholder book is stored before the real one is validated.

edits.old:
Book book(title, author, static_cast<int>(books_.size()) + 1);  // validates before anything is stored
        books_.push_back(std::move(book));
edits.new:

name: fine-is-one-day-too-many
why: the fine counts one extra day.

edits.old: if (today > b.due_) fine = static_cast<long long>(today - b.due_) * fine_per_day;
edits.new: if (today > b.due_) fine = static_cast<long long>(today - b.due_ + 1) * fine_per_day;

name: fine-overflows-an-int
why: the fine is computed in int.

edits.old: if (today > b.due_) fine = static_cast<long long>(today - b.due_) * fine_per_day;
edits.new: if (today > b.due_) fine = static_cast<long long>((today - b.due_) * static_cast<int>(fine_per_day));

name: fine-rate-is-wrong
why: 20 cents a day.

edits.old: if (today > b.due_) fine = static_cast<long long>(today - b.due_) * fine_per_day;
edits.new: if (today > b.due_) fine = static_cast<long long>(today - b.due_) * 20;
